name: Discord
description: Discord is a voice, video, and text communication service used by tens of millions of people to talk and hang out with their communities and friends.

evidence.claim: Authenticating with the Discord API can be done using a bot token or an OAuth2 bearer token.
The Discord API is a REST API that allows you to interact with Discord data from your own applications.
Community MCP server exists for Discord allowing AI assistants to manage channels, send messages, and retrieve server info.

notes: Discord provides a robust REST API and Gateway WebSocket connection for bots and applications, supporting both bot tokens and OAuth2 authentication.
